name: launch
description: Default plane environment: the model sits on the pad, is rotated onto the launch attitude (hand or rail, 10 deg nose up) and waits for a `launch` command, which uses the parameters below unless the command overrides them. Give the launch step a number instead of null to launch automatically at that time. 50 km/h in 0.5 s is 27.8 m/s^2 (IMU X 29.5 m/s^2 at 10 deg): above 1.2 x iNav's nav_fw_launch_accel (18.63 m/s^2) for the whole 0.5 s ramp, so NAV LAUNCH's bungee detector fires.
